title: Machining Playbook Orchestration & Auto-Pipeline Integration
description: Wire MachiningPlaybookEngine into PRISM's automatic pipelines so experiential machining wisdom (sequencing, anti-patterns, setup strategy) is automatically surfaced when users run process planning, G-code intelligence pipeline, feature interaction analysis, or speed/feed optimization. Create hooks, skills, and cross-engine fusion points.

units.title: Create post-process-plan hook that auto-injects playbook sequencing validation
steps: Add hook M-PB-001 in AdvancedManufacturingHooks.ts: after process_plan_generate, validate operation sequence against playbook rules
Hook calls machiningPlaybookEngine.sequenceAdvice(features, material) and surfaces warnings for any anti-pattern violations
Hook calls machiningPlaybookEngine.setupAdvice() and appends workholding/datum suggestions to the plan result
Severity: WARN for recommended rules, BLOCK for critical anti-patterns (e.g., finishing before roughing)
Add hook M-PB-002: pre-cam-toolpath hook that surfaces toolpath strategy rules when generating CAM operations
Register both hooks in HookRegistry with proper metadata
exit_conditions: Both hooks registered and callable
Hook M-PB-001 fires on process_plan_generate and returns sequencing warnings
Hook M-PB-002 fires on cam toolpath actions and returns strategy advice
Tests verify hook triggering and rule matching

phases.title: Pipeline Integration — Chain Playbook into GCodeIntelligencePipeline

units.title: Add Stage 0 (Playbook Pre-Check) to GCodeIntelligencePipelineEngine
steps: Add optional Stage 0 before Safety Analysis: PlaybookPreCheck
Stage 0 extracts operation types from G-code comments/structure, maps to features
Calls machiningPlaybookEngine.advise() with detected features and material
Surfaces critical warnings in pipeline result (e.g., 'roughing and finishing interleaved — SEQ-003 violation')
Passes anti-pattern flags to subsequent stages (e.g., 'ANTI-004: flood coolant on carbide detected')
Stage result included in pipeline output under 'playbook_warnings' key
Add playbook_enabled flag to pipeline config (default: true)
exit_conditions: Pipeline runs 7 stages (0-6) when playbook_enabled=true
Pipeline still runs 6 stages when playbook_enabled=false (backward compatible)
Playbook warnings appear in pipeline result
Existing tests still pass

units.title: Wire playbook validation into ProcessPlanEngine and FeatureInteractionEngine
steps: In ProcessPlanEngine.generate(): after generating operation sequence, call playbook.sequenceAdvice() to validate
Append playbook_warnings and playbook_suggestions to ProcessPlanResult
In FeatureInteractionEngine.minimizeSetups(): after grouping features, call playbook.setupAdvice() for workholding wisdom
Append workholding_suggestions and datum_strategy to SetupResult
Add cross-reference: FeatureInteraction precedence violations that match playbook anti-patterns get elevated severity
Ensure both engines import machiningPlaybookEngine singleton
exit_conditions: process_plan_generate returns playbook_warnings in result
feature_minimize_setups returns workholding_suggestions
Anti-pattern matches from playbook elevate precedence violation severity
No regressions in existing ProcessPlan/FeatureInteraction tests

units.title: Create /playbook skill for direct querying
steps: Create C:/Users/Admin.DIGITALSTORM-PC/.claude/commands/playbook.md

Args: empty (show stats), 'sequence <features>' (sequencing advice), 'setup <features>' (setup strategy), 'antipatterns' (list all), 'lookup <category>' (browse by category), 'material <iso>' (material-specific tips), 'add' (interactive rule addition)
Skill calls shopPracticeDispatcher playbook_* actions
Output formatted as actionable machining advice with rule IDs for traceability
Include examples in help text
exit_conditions: /playbook command callable and returns formatted advice
/playbook sequence hole,pocket,thread returns ordered operations
/playbook antipatterns returns all anti-pattern rules

phases.title: Auto-Enrichment — Playbook Rules from Video Pipeline

units.title: Wire playbook extraction into VideoLearningEngine output
steps: In VideoLearningEngine: after knowledge extraction, detect sequencing/best-practice content
Map extracted practices to PlaybookRule structure with proper categorization
Auto-call playbook_add_rule for new unique rules (dedup by checking existing rule titles/content)
Add playbook_rules_extracted count to video learning result
Update video-learn skill to report playbook rules extracted
Add provenance: source field = 'VideoLearning — [channel] — [title] ([URL])'
exit_conditions: VideoLearningEngine outputs playbook_rules in its result
New rules auto-added to playbook with proper source provenance
Duplicate rules detected and skipped
Video learning result includes playbook_rules_extracted count
